_what_this_is: Alternative mandates for the same grant. Each scenario is a deployer's sentence and the primitives it wants and refuses; everything else is unstated. The grant never changes; the delta is recomputed per scenario. Written on this site as starting points to be argued with.

scenarios.label: Search my mail and files
scenarios.description: Find things; never send, never change.

scenarios.label: Draft replies, I send
scenarios.description: Write drafts in my mailbox; sending is mine.

scenarios.label: Create documents from my notes
scenarios.description: Make new Docs and Sheets from what I give it.

scenarios.label: Schedule meetings
scenarios.description: Find a slot and put it in the calendar.

scenarios.label: A full assistant over Workspace
scenarios.description: Mail, files, documents: read and write all of it.
